description: China University of Mining and Technology researchers identify operating industrial heat sources across ASEAN during 2012–2021. The dataset uses 375-metre NPP-VIIRS active-fire observations and spatial segmentation to delineate sources associated with energy-intensive industry. Attributes include coordinates, administrative location and the first and last detected operating years. ScienceDB lists XLSX spreadsheet files for the industrial objects and explanatory metadata. The deposit is freely reusable under CC BY 4.0. These are satellite-detected heat sources, so detection dates should not be treated as verified commissioning or closure dates. Low-temperature facilities and intermittent operations may be missed. The inventory can provide industrial-location and activity proxies for regional energy-demand or infrastructure-exposure simulations. It does not directly measure electricity consumption. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
